title: Uwavuzwe mu Rugo rw'Umuhanuzi
intro: Mu rugo rw’intumwa ya nyuma, harimwo umutima inkuru yiwe bwite yacitse icigwa c’Imana ku bemera bose. Ubuzima bw’uwo muntu bwari bufitaniye isano cane n’itegeko ry’uguhindura abantu ryahinduye imigenzo y’imibano ibihe bidahera, ivyo bikaba vyari ikimenyetso c’ihinduka rikomeye mu kuntu ukwizera kwosobanura umuryango n’ukuba uwo mu muryango.
clues: Izina ryanje ryari risanzwe rifitaniye isano n’uruvyaro rw’icubahiro, mugabo ukuri kwo hejuru kwohavuye gutomora imigozi nyakuri y’ukwizera.
Nari uwaronse ubuntu bwinshi buva kuri Allah n’intumwa yiwe, ubuntu bwamenyeshejwe ku mugaragaro mu gitabu.
Ubuzima bwanje bwo mu rugo bwacitse ikigeragezo gihambaye cohindura ubuziraherezo ukuntu abantu babona imigenderanire y’abavyeyi.
Ni jewe ikigeragezo canje bwite catumye ngira itegeko ry’Imana ryemerera Umuhanuzi kurongora umugore maze kugenda.
Biciye mu nkuru yanje, itandukaniro riri hagati y’umuryango w’abavyeyi n’uwatowe ryarasobanuwe neza ku mayaruka yose.
Ni jewe jenyene mu bagenzi banje izina ryiwe riboneka mu buryo butomoye mw’ihishurwa rya nyuma, atari nk’umuhanuzi, ariko nk’umusuku yageragejwe kandi yubahwa.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
